data.title: Two prices on one card
data.situation:
Eli came in with a torn handle and a budget of twenty pounds. He wanted to compare a repair with buying a new bag. Jay wrote both prices on a card before starting any work. Mina’s charging policy was simple: the estimate came first, and a bill would follow only after the agreed repair was finished. For Eli, this was a small but real financial decision. The repair cost a large proportion of the price of a plain new bag, but his old bag had useful pockets. He traced one of them with his finger and asked Jay whether the new handle would be as strong as the original. Jay turned the card over and drew the two rows of stitching he planned to use. ESTIMATE FOR ELI
Replace handle and reinforce stitching: £15.
New plain bag: £18.
Add a matching inner pocket to the new bag: £3.
The pocket charge is equal to the difference between the repair and the plain new bag.
Please confirm your choice before work begins.

readingBlocks.zh: 伊莱拿着提手破损的包进店，预算是二十英镑。他想比较维修和买新包。动手之前，杰伊把两个价格写在同一张卡上。米娜的收费办法很简单：先报价，约定的维修完成后再出账单。对伊莱来说，这是一个金额不大但实际的财务决定。维修费占普通新包价格的很大一部分，但旧包有好用的口袋。他用手指沿一个口袋摸了摸，问新提手是否会像原来一样牢固。杰伊把卡片翻过来，画下计划使用的两排缝线。

readingBlocks.en:
ESTIMATE FOR ELI
Replace handle and reinforce stitching: £15.
New plain bag: £18.
Add a matching inner pocket to the new bag: £3.
The pocket charge is equal to the difference between the repair and the plain new bag.
Please confirm your choice before work begins.
readingBlocks.zh:
伊莱的报价单
换提手并加固缝线：15 英镑。
新的普通包：18 英镑。
给新包加一个配套内袋：3 英镑。
内袋费用等于维修与普通新包的差价。
开始工作前，请确认选择。

glossary.note: a budget of + 金额；within the budget：在预算以内。
glossary.example: Eli had a budget of twenty pounds.
glossary.exampleZh: 伊莱的预算是二十英镑。

glossary.note: bill 列出应付金额；receipt 通常表示已付款的凭证。
glossary.example: Eli would receive a bill after the agreed repair.
glossary.exampleZh: 约定的维修完成后，伊莱会收到账单。

glossary.note: charging policy：收费政策；这里不是给设备充电。
financial 此处涉及费用；不是必须与银行金融机构有关。
glossary.example: Eli had to make a financial decision.
glossary.exampleZh: 伊莱需要作出一项财务决定。

glossary.zh: 整体中的一部分或占比
glossary.note: a proportion of a whole；本例 15/18，不等于维修费本身。
glossary.example: The repair cost a large proportion of the price of a new bag.
glossary.exampleZh: 维修费占新包价格的很大一部分。

externalEvidence.definition: the quotient obtained when the magnitude of a part is divided by the magnitude of the whole

glossary.note: be equal to + 数值或比较对象；这里不是 be equal to a task 的能力义。
glossary.example: The pocket charge was equal to the three-pound difference.
glossary.exampleZh: 内袋费用等于三英镑的差价。
